name: RGV Regression Check

# Manual only. Reruns one of the two exposed Reference-Grounded Validation
# case sets (v1 or v2 -- select via the "tag" input) against whatever
# engine code is on the selected branch. See the 2026-08-10 note in
# run_final_reference_holdout_v1.py for why v1 and v2 now use separate,
# versioned label/result filenames (they used to share one filename and
# v2's run silently destroyed v1's frozen labels).
#
# This is explicitly a REGRESSION check, not a fresh/independent validity
# estimate -- these 24 cases are exposed (the engine has effectively "seen"
# them across prior remediation rounds) and must never be reported as an
# unbiased accuracy number. See run_final_reference_holdout_v1.py and the
# integrity rule in FINAL_REFERENCE_GROUNDED_VALIDATION_V2_REPORT.md.
#
# Needs real network access to Supabase (the engine loads
# evidence_records_df / plant_compounds_df / etc. from the live database
# even when the case's own evidence is injected via a frozen snapshot) and
# to OpenAI (semantic-relevance embeddings), so this cannot run in a
# sandboxed/offline environment -- that's why it's a workflow, not
# something run locally.
"on":
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: "Which exposed case set to run as a regression check"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - v1
          - v2
        default: v2

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  rgv-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
      SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
      SUPABASE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_KEY }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install requirements
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Validate secrets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "$OPENAI_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Actions secret: OPENAI_API_KEY"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$SUPABASE_URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Actions secret: SUPABASE_URL"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$SUPABASE_KEY" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Actions secret: SUPABASE_KEY"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run RGV regression (selected case set)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python run_final_reference_holdout_v1.py --tag "$TAG" > rgv_run_full.log 2>&1 || {
            echo "::error::run_final_reference_holdout_v1.py failed -- see the log below."
            cat rgv_run_full.log
            exit 1
          }

      - name: Print clean summary (metrics + per-case results)
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE="gold_corpus/scientific_validity/final_holdout_v1"
          echo "===== tag: $TAG ====="
          echo "===== metrics (blind_results_${TAG}.json) ====="
          python -m json.tool "$BASE/blind_results_${TAG}.json"
          echo
          echo "===== release gate (release_gate_result_${TAG}.json) ====="
          python -m json.tool "$BASE/release_gate_result_${TAG}.json"

      - name: Upload full run log (only shown if something looked wrong above)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rgv-regression-full-log
          path: rgv_run_full.log
          retention-days: 14
